description: The garden on its slope on its street, read by an implementation of FS_context that knows it: Garden Lane along the lot's front, its sidewalk's back on the lot line - a 30' carriageway with a 6" curb, a 4' strip and a 5' sidewalk on each side, 49' overall and 130' long; a one-storey neighbour to the west with a gable roof, a two-storey neighbour to the east with a hip roof, a flat-roofed one across the street, and two trees beyond the rear lot line. It is valid and reports nothing - every record stands beyond the lot - and derives each street's length and overall width, each neighbour's footprint area, eaves and ridge, and each tree's top; everything else it derives is what the same house derives without its context (1.5).
